fact: At the ARTAC extraordinary session ending 20 August 2025, Chad's regulator said the joint frequency roadmap with Cameroon had removed intrusive signals in N'Djamena, while free roaming between the two countries was still pending.
title: Télécoms: L'ART et l'ARCEP Tchad évaluent leurs engagements bilatéraux à la 3e Session extra de l'ARTAC
